incidents.name: WIFCOIN staking claimEarned replay
incidents.notes: WifStaking.claimEarned(stakingId, burnRate) paid the accrued reward without resetting the staker's accrual checkpoint, so the attacker staked a small position bought with 0.3 ETH and looped claimEarned until the staking contract's WIF balance was drained.

sources.ref: onchain review: WifStaking 0xA1cE40702E15d0417a6c74D0bAB96772F36F4E99 created 2024-06-10T00:26:59Z by 0xa2f4d24b29e33238bd590e7be0b991e97532a069, not the attack-tx sender 0x394ba273315240510b61ca22ba152e3478a45892; no EIP-1967 events, 6.3 days old. A second drain transaction 0x58424115c6576b19cfb78b0b7ff00e0c13daa06d259f2a67210c112731519e09 hits the same contract and is not recorded separately. ~3.4 ETH at a June 2024 ETH price near $3,500 is roughly $12k. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 3.4 ETH x $3,555.13 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $12,087.
